कुथ् कुथ्, cl. 4. P. कुथ्यति, चुकोथ,
अकोथीत्, कोथिष्यति, कोथितुम्, to stink,
to become putrid: Caus. P. कोथयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to putrify.

कुथ कुथ, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. a painted or
variegated cloth or blanket, serving as an elephant's
housings; (अस्), m. sacrificial or Kuśa grass, Poa
Cynosuroides; Śākya-muni in one of his former
thirty-four births.
कुथुमि कुथुमि, इस्, m., N. of a Muni.
कुथुमिन् कुथुमिन्, ई, m., N. of a man.
